title: Causal completion relay read: post-reply link authority check can block the recovery worker on the link mutex without bound
outcome: The causal completion pull's authority checks after a verified relay reply have bounded or fail-fast lock admission. Contention on the federation link mutex defers the read with a local post-read reason instead of holding the recovery worker indefinitely, and a verified reply is still kept when the check succeeds.
acceptance: request_mailbox_relay_checked's post-response lease.with_current, and the in-RPC post-MAC authority checks that take the same federation link mutex, acquire it with a bound or fail fast; contention is reported to the causal pull as a typed local post-read deferral, not an origin failure and not an unbounded wait.
A verified, settled reply is still delivered when the bounded authority check succeeds, preserving the false-positive ruling about deadlines during that check.

A deterministic test holds the link mutex (for example through a native append settlement held at COMMIT) while a causal read's reply is verified, and asserts the read ends with the typed local deferral within the test's deadlock guard.
